Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup

Class IntegrationTestBackupRestoreBase

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.AbstractHBaseTool
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.IntegrationTestBase
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.IntegrationTestBackupRestoreBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configurable, org.apache.hadoop.util.Tool
Direct Known Subclasses:
IntegrationTestBackupRestore, IntegrationTestContinuousBackupRestore
public abstract class IntegrationTestBackupRestoreBase extends IntegrationTestBase
An abstract base class that is used to run backup, restore, and delete integration tests. This class performs both full backups and incremental backups. Both continuous backup and non-continuous backup test cases are supported. The number of incremental backups performed depends on the number of iterations defined by the user. The class performs the backup/restore in a separate thread, where one thread is created per table. The number of tables is user-defined, along with other various configurations.

    • runTestSingle

      private void runTestSingle(org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName tableName, boolean isContinuousBackupEnabled) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      This method is what performs the actual backup, restore, merge, and delete operations. This method is run in a separate thread. It first performs a full backup. After, it iteratively performs a series of incremental backups and restores. Later, it deletes the backups.
      Parameters:
      tableName - The table the backups are performed on
      isContinuousBackupEnabled - Boolean flag used to indicate if the backups should have continuous backup enabled.
      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException

    • verifyWALPartitionDirExists

      private org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path verifyWALPartitionDirExists(org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path backupWALs) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Waits for a WAL partition directory to exist inside the backup WAL directory. The directory should be something like: .../backupWALDir/WALs/2025-10-17. The directory's existence is either eventually asserted, or an assertion error is thrown if it does not exist past the wait deadline. This verification is to be used for full backups with continuous backup enabled.
      Parameters:
      backupWALs - The directory that should contain the partition directory. i.e. .../backupWALDir/WALs
      Returns:
      The Path to the WAL partition directory
      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException

    • verifyBackupWALFiles

      private void verifyBackupWALFiles(org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path walPartitionDir) throws IOException
      Verifies the WAL partition directory contains a backup WAL file. The WAL file's path will look something like the following: .../backupWALDir/WALs/2025-10-17/wal_file.1760738249595.1880be89-0b69-4bad-8d0e-acbf25c63b7e
      Parameters:
      walPartitionDir - The date directory for a backup WAL i.e. .../backupWALDir/WALs/2025-10-17
      Throws:
      IOException
